environment.description: Kubernetes pod running OpenJDK 17 on Ubuntu 22.04 with default container runtime (runc) and no seccomp profile applied. Pod spec uses securityContext.seccompProfile.type: Unconfined. The JNI native library is compiled without stack canaries (-fno-stack-protector) and ASLR is disabled in the container (kernel.randomize_va_space=0 via privileged init container). Container runs as root.
